# Manuel Bomheker

> Strategic communication for universities, science and innovation.

Official English website: https://manuelbomheker.com/en/

Manuel Bomheker works with universities, scientific institutions, innovation teams and university incubators that need to organize communication decisions, make institutional value easier to understand and build trust with strategic audiences.

## Main services

- Strategic consulting in institutional communication.
- Communication diagnosis, positioning and message architecture.
- Strategy for engagement, transfer, innovation and funding.
- Communication governance, decision criteria, processes and channels.
- Tactical advisory for calls, identity, narratives, documents and presentations.
- Training and mentoring for researchers, communication teams and university incubators.
- Academic personal branding, science communication, pitch and idea validation.

## Problems addressed

- The institution creates value, but struggles to explain it.
- The channels exist, but they do not work as a system.
- Key relationships lack institutional continuity.

## Approach

The work turns scattered communication into a system of criteria, messages, processes, channels and tools. The goal is to help academic, scientific and innovation organizations make better decisions, communicate more clearly and build continuity with key stakeholders.

## Experience

Experience in academic, scientific and innovation organizations, including the National University of Córdoba, the School of Exact, Physical and Natural Sciences, DASPU, the Federal Council of Engineering Deans, the Association of Universities Grupo Montevideo, the National Interuniversity Council, the National University of Cuyo, university incubators, the National University of the Northeast, CONICET and scientific institutes.

## Public content

- YouTube: interviews and classes on strategic communication and brand management for academic institutions.
- Medium: notes, resources and experiences on communication management, institutional diagnosis and academic organizations.
- LinkedIn: lessons, cases, reflections and work experiences in strategic communication, brand and institutional management.
